attribution: HierText: Long, Qin, Panteleev, Bissacco, Fujii, Raptis; Google Research; original images selected from Open Images; retain official dataset license and source attribution

rule.images: first two JPEG file members in official test.tgz archive order; no replacements
rule.lineOrder: image archive order, then official paragraph array and line array order
rule.filters: legible=true, handwritten=false, vertical=false; nonempty 1..100 codepoints, each U+0020..U+007E; line top-edge absolute atan2 angle <=5 degrees; bounding rectangle within image, positive dimensions
rule.crop: floor minima / ceil maxima of official line vertices, axis-aligned RGB crop, no padding/rotation/rectification
rule.metrics: exact raw official line text vs raw CTC text; case/whitespace/punctuation retained; aggregate codepoint Levenshtein CER; no Unicode normalization or failure removal
rule.scope: Real HierText public scene text subset, oracle official line geometry; not document field quality, text detection or independent product acceptance
